convert_voxtral_weights_to_hf: convert Voxtral model weights from Csm format to Hugging Face Transformers format
convert_config: convert the original Voxtral config dictionary to a VoxtralConfig object with text and audio sub-configs
convert_state_dict: convert a state dict from the original format to Hugging Face format with ROPE permutation for attention weights
write_model: write the converted Voxtral model checkpoint and saved weights to an output directory
write_processor: create and save a VoxtralProcessor with MistralCommonBackend tokenizer and WhisperFeatureExtractor
